summary: Continue-conversation button on share page with Clerk sign-in redirect flow
description: Continue-conversation button on /share/[slug]. Signed-in: POST fork -> router.push(/chat/{sessionId}). Signed-out: Clerk sign-in/sign-up with redirect_url back to /share/[slug]?continue=1; on return, auto-trigger fork once (guard against double-fork on refresh). Hide/disable gracefully when Clerk is disabled (tailnet host). Done: manual verification of both auth paths + feature note; test the continue=1 guard if practical.

resolution.test_function: auto-fork strips the param (refresh-safe) and dedupes via sessionStorage (bfcache-safe)
resolution.note: ContinueButton: signed-in click forks + router.push(/chat/[id]); signed-out bounces /sign-in?redirect_url=/share/[slug]?continue=1 (redirect_url wins over fallbackRedirectUrl per todo:7069e9aa); on return the effect waits for isSignedIn, strips the param via replaceState, dedupes via sessionStorage, forks once. Page renders it only when clerkEnabled() (tailnet-safe). E2E smoke on dev server (port 3210, real DB): share page 200 with snapshot content + citation card + noindex + CITATIONS tail stripped; unknown + revoked slug 404; unauthed share/fork POST 401. Signed-in Clerk round-trip needs a browser — left for the user's pass.
